Messages.Author: George Fink
Messages.Body:
In JOL2 my prey put a Society of Leopold on my 0 blood Smudge. What
happens on my next untap? He has no blood to lose, so does that mean
he is automatically burned with no recourse?

--George

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:


Remember that you get to order your untap effects in the order you wish.
So you could give Smudge blood from a Hunting Ground, and then resolve
Society, allowing Smudge to burn 1 blood rather than himself. But if you
have no way to give him blood during your untap then he is burned without
recourse, yes.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
gf...@avalon.cs.ucdavis.edu (George Fink) writes:
>In JOL2 my prey put a Society of Leopold on my 0 blood Smudge. What
>happens on my next untap? He has no blood to lose, so does that mean
>he is automatically burned with no recourse?

Yes, unless you have a hunting groud (or other mechanism to put a blood
on Smudge before the end of your untap).
